quote: StrictMode is most commonly used to catch accidental disk or network access on the application's main thread
note: StrictMode 頁講主執行緒磁碟存取要避免;ANR 頁寫主執行緒做 I/O 是 ANR 常見模式,並建議 withContext(Dispatchers.IO)。apply()/DataStore 與 Room 預設行為這次未逐項開頁。

quote: A common use of thread annotations is to validate that methods or classes annotated with @WorkerThread are only called from an appropriate background thread.
note: 官方標註頁與 WrongThread 規則說明支持執行緒標註核對;WrongThreadInterprocedural 預設關、CalledFromWrongThreadException 未在這兩頁找到,只算核心主張成立。

quote: Runs the given block in-place in a new coroutine based on context, blocking the current thread until its completion, and then returning its result.
note: runBlocking 官方文件明寫阻塞當前執行緒且只該用於 main、測試與非 suspend 回呼;主執行緒阻塞致 ANR 見 ANR 頁。DataStore 頁沒有 runBlocking 字句,但有『Avoid reading from or writing to DataStore directly within your composable functions』。

quote: The main thread is blocked waiting for a synchronized block for a long operation that is happening on another thread.
note: ANR 頁列出主執行緒等鎖與死結為 ANR 成因,並建議用 Mutex.withLock 取代原始鎖。future.get/latch/join 未逐字出現,屬同類阻塞。

quote: The app is doing a long calculation on the main thread.
note: ANR 頁有 Slow code on the main thread 一節,示範 Composable 內排序/運算是壞寫法,修法是移到 ViewModel 狀態。Regex 提成頂層 val 這個細節未找到出處。

quote: content providers are expensive to instantiate and can slow down the startup sequence unnecessarily.
note: App Startup 頁支持用 Initializer 與 dependencies() 取代每個函式庫一個 ContentProvider;launch-time 頁寫 Application.onCreate 做重活會拖慢啟動,解法是延遲初始化。

quote: If you don't call reportFullyDrawn, no TTFD value is reported.
note: Baseline Profile 頁說明 baseline-prof.txt 與 AOT 預編譯改善啟動;launch-time 頁說明 reportFullyDrawn 與 Compose 的 ReportDrawnWhen。

quote: This API enables a faster startup time and lets you tweak your splash screen in the following ways
note: Custom splash screens 一節指出用獨立 Activity 做 splash 會增加啟動時間,Android 12 起要遷移到 SplashScreen API。installSplashScreen() 放 MainActivity 的細節未逐字確認。

quote: Many resources, such as TypedArrays, VelocityTrackers, etc., should be recycled (with a recycle() call) after use.
note: Recycle lint 說明支持 TypedArray/VelocityTracker recycle;StrictMode 頁 enableDefaults 寫明會抓 leaked SQLite cursors。detekt MissingUseCall 是否涵蓋 Cursor 未查。

quote: You should avoid allocating objects during a drawing or layout operation.
note: DrawAllocation 說明另寫:These are called frequently, so a smooth UI can be interrupted by garbage collection pauses,且建議預先配置並重用。

quote: LayoutManagers will be forced to fully rebind and relayout all visible views.
note: NotifyDataSetChanged 規則說明吻合後果;ListAdapter+DiffUtil 的建議未在此頁逐字確認。

quote: When implementing a view Adapter, you should avoid unconditionally inflating a new layout;
note: ViewHolder 規則說明另寫 This helps make for example ListView scrolling much smoother。

quote: These methods attempt to allocate memory for the constructed bitmap and therefore can easily result in an OutOfMemory exception.
note: 官方載入大型 Bitmap 教學,建議用 inSampleSize 載入縮小版本,並推薦 Glide/Coil 等函式庫。

quote: keeping recently referenced objects in a strong referenced LinkedHashMap and evicting the least recently used member before the cache exceeds its designated size.
note: 官方 Bitmap 快取頁示範 LruCache 並覆寫 sizeOf,且警告 cache 過大會造成 OutOfMemory。

quote: For maps where the keys are of type integer, it's typically more efficient to use the Android SparseArray API.
note: UseSparseArrays 規則說明吻合。

quote: Using Array<Primitive> leads to implicit boxing and performance hit. Prefer using Kotlin specialized Array Instances.
note: detekt ArrayPrimitive 規則說明吻合。

quote: In most cases using a spread operator causes a full copy of the array to be created before calling a method.
note: detekt SpreadOperator 規則說明吻合。

quote: Using the forEach method on ranges has a heavy performance cost. Prefer using simple for loops.
note: detekt ForEachOnRange 規則說明吻合。

quote: Prefer passing java.util.Locale explicitly than using implicit default value when formatting strings
note: detekt ImplicitDefaultLocale 說明支持標準寫法;土耳其語系出錯這個後果的原文未在該頁找到,只算核心成立。

quote: When you concatenate strings with the + operator, Kotlin creates a new String object for each operation. However, this approach may not be beneficial in loops or when you assemble many pieces.
note: Kotlin 官方字串頁建議 buildString 或 StringBuilder。O(n²) 字樣官方沒寫,屬推論;detekt performance 清單確實沒有對應規則,與型錄『待查』一致。

quote: Avoid temporary objects when converting primitive types to String.
note: detekt UnnecessaryTemporaryInstantiation 規則說明吻合。

quote: Prefer codegen for better performance and to avoid the kotlin-reflect dependency.
note: Moshi README 建議 codegen,並寫反射序列化搭配 R8 要加 keep 規則;kotlinx.serialization README 稱 reflectionless、由編譯器外掛生成。『Gson 解析大量物件』與『每幀』的說法無官方出處。
型錄來源欄自己標明無網址、未開頁核對,是一般演算法知識(O(n²) 與 list.contains 線性查詢)。我沒找到講 Kotlin 這兩種寫法的權威頁面,不編造出處。

quote: if the value is null, the !! operator forces it to be treated as non-nullable, which results in an NPE.
note: Kotlin 官方 null-safety 頁示範以 ?. 與 ?: 取代 !!;detekt UnsafeCallOnNullableType、MapGetWithNotNullAssertionOperator、UnnecessaryNotNullOperator 皆存在。官方頁並未叫人完全禁用 !!,但與型錄不相反。

quote: If you access a lateinit property before initializing it, Kotlin throws a specific exception that identifies the uninitialized property being accessed
note: Kotlin 屬性頁同時給出 this::x.isInitialized 檢查;detekt LateinitUsage 規則存在。『預設關』未逐字確認。

quote: This rule reports mutable properties inside data classes.
note: detekt DataClassShouldBeImmutable 與 DoubleMutabilityForCollection 存在;Kotlin 官方頁說 equals/hashCode 由主建構式屬性產生。放進 HashSet 後雜湊改變的後果屬 Java 集合契約推論,頁面未逐字寫。

quote: When overriding the equals() function, you should also override the hashCode() function to keep consistency between equality and hashing and ensure the proper behavior of these functions.
note: Kotlin 官方 equality 頁並寫 equals 參數是 equals(Any?);detekt EqualsWithHashCodeExist、WrongEqualsTypeParameter、EqualsAlwaysReturnsTrueOrFalse 皆存在。

quote: It doesn't incur any thread-safety guarantees and related overhead.
note: 官方頁:預設 lazy 為 synchronized,確定同執行緒才用 NONE。多執行緒用 NONE 會初始化兩次或拿到半成品的後果未逐字寫,屬『沒有執行緒安全保證』的推論。

quote: If a cast fails with the as operator, a ClassCastException is thrown at runtime.
note: Kotlin 官方頁並說 as? 失敗回傳 null;detekt HasPlatformType 寫 Platform types must be declared explicitly in public APIs to prevent unexpected errors;CastNullableToNonNullableType、IgnoredReturnValue 皆存在。detekt UnsafeCast 實際描述是『Reports casts that will never succeed』,與型錄寫的一般不安全轉型略有差距,但不相反。

quote: Referential equality verifies the memory addresses of two objects to determine if they are the same instance.
note: 官方 equality 頁區分 == 結構相等與 === 參考相等;detekt AvoidReferentialEquality 存在。

quote: Long chains of collection operations will have a performance penalty due to a new list being created for each call.
note: detekt CouldBeSequence 規則說明吻合。
